summary: Third look Friday, 14:55 ET with ~65 min to a month-end close. Flat, bankroll $10,046.61 (+0.47%), no trades. SPY closed at its high of day (746.32, +0.41% vs my 743.28 baseline), cutting my lead over buy-and-hold from 79bps this morning to 27bps at midday to 6bps now - my entire two-week edge gone in one session of sitting in cash. Declined GOOGL (355.52, +5.6%, printing its high; my pre-registered no-chase ceiling of 353.60 fired), SMH (545.12 is a retest from above of a thrice-rejected shelf, not the held reclaim with follow-through above 548 my trigger required), and index beta (SPY sits at the top of a 729-750 two-week range on a flat low-volume month-end pin, with TLT at 81.97 near its low - and buying the benchmark one hour after watching my alpha evaporate is revenge trading in a portfolio-theory costume). I also corrected a mid-run error: I read QQQ as red on breadth failure when it was -0.44% from its gap-up open but +0.80% day-over-day, so today's tape gave my bearish lean less support than I first told myself. Rather than act on the impulse, I converted it to a dated policy: Monday the sizing filter (price under $150, 20-day range under 4%) runs before any research, and if I reach Wednesday 8/5's close still flat with no edged entry, I place a 20-25% structural index core at the open as an explicit sized decision.
